scope: single-section marker-supported spatial sensitivity; not untouched multicohort clinical validation
basic_QC: gene-expression counts>=50 and detected gene-expression features>=20; finite native centroids and positive cell area
nuclear_policies: all cells passing other QC sensitivity including3121 zero-nucleus boundary-segmented cells
EC: >=2 primary or>=3 sensitivity among PECAM1/CDH5/KDR/ERG/CLDN5 AND CDH5 or ERG detected; exclude >=2 PROX1/PDPN/FLT4 lymphatic program
PC: >=2 ABCC9/KCNJ8/CSPG4/PDGFRB AND ABCC9 or KCNJ8 detected; MYH11/ACTA2/TAGLN/CNN1 unmeasured so no contractile exclusion possible
MF: both CD68 and CSF1R detected; myeloid proxy, not exact macrophage subtype
conflicts: exclude EPCAM>=2 RNA or both CD3E/CD3G or>=2 CD79A/CD79B/MS4A1; exclude overlap of EC/PC/MF support masks
auxiliary_threshold: >=1RNA unless explicitly stated; ESM1/RGS5/FOLR2 never used in identity gate
tests: all6 ordered pairs of3 core proxies x2 marker thresholds(1,2) x2 radii(30,50um) x2 tiles(200,400um) x2 EC gates x2 nuclear policies=192 planned; exact blocked-label conditional null as prior breast; joint BH with audited prior274 tests, all exclusions retained
interpretation: two-way proximity tests do not prove simultaneous three-cell hub or ligand receptor signaling; absent contractile markers prevent precise pericyte exclusion
